connector.name: Civicrm MCP
connector.registryDescription: Model Context Protocol server for CiviCRM - AuthX-first, schema-introspected, write-gated.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package civicrm-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the yogiadhik account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CIVICRM_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the CiviCRM install, e.g. https://crm.example.org. No trailing slash.

env.name: CIVICRM_API_KEY
env.description: API key of the contact the server authenticates as. Keep it on a dedicated 'MCP Bot' contact with minimum permissions.

env.name: CIVICRM_CMS
env.description: CMS host: drupal, wordpress, standalone, or backdrop.

env.name: CIVICRM_SITE_KEY
env.description: Optional — only needed if the site enables the AuthX site-key guard.

env.name: CIVICRM_AUTH_MODE
env.description: authx (default, recommended) or legacy for pre-5.36 installs.

env.name: CIVICRM_ALLOW_WRITES
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable create / update / save / submit actions. Off by default.

env.name: CIVICRM_ALLOW_DELETES
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable delete / replace actions. Off by default.
